question: Which Article provides the President with the power to declare Financial Emergency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 360**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Article 360** of the **Indian Constitution** empowers the President of India to declare a **Financial Emergency** in the country if he/she is satisfied that the financial stability or credit of India or any part of its territory is threatened. 
• During a Financial Emergency, the **executive authority of the Union** extends over all financial matters in the country.
